section_heading: 6.6.3 Syncrolift at the Port of Cape Town; 6.6.4 Minimum fees
plain_summary: This page details the tariff fees for using the Syncrolift at the Port of Cape Town, broken down by vessel gross tonnage and duration of use (first 24 hours or subsequent 12-hour periods). It also specifies minimum fees for various drydocks (Sturrock, Prince Edward, Princess Elizabeth, Robinson, Floating docks) and the Syncrolift, again based on duration. The page includes notes regarding additional charges for shifting docking blocks, recovery of damage caused by bar/box keel vessels, and potential special conditions for Medical/Research vessels or companies drydocking multiple vessels within a 12-month period.
